copy.headline: FANNIN THE FLAMES
copy.dek: @sedwards1495 posted the week's top score and buried @nseldeib, thanks to two Harold Fannin touchdowns nobody saw coming.
copy.hero_caption: Purdy plus Fannin covered that by themselves.
copy.story_title: sedwards1495 Erupts, PopPop4126 Benches the Winner, and EaglesRx Can't Lose in Rio
story: Harold Fannin entered Sunday projected for single digits and left with two touchdowns, and @sedwards1495 fanned that spark into a wildfire. Brock Purdy threw four more, the lineup posted the week's top score, and @nseldeib absorbed a 53.46-point loss on the same day Tyler Loop drilled a 56-yard walk-off in Rio. Right kicker, wrong scoreboard. @sedwards1495 hasn't dipped under 127 all season, which is less a hot streak than a home address.

That Rio thriller had a fantasy subplot: @EaglesRx started Lamar Jackson and CeeDee Lamb on opposite sidelines, the one game no manager could lose, and the season's first win finally arrived by hedging the NFL itself. @PopPop4126 drew the opposite fortune. Juwan Johnson caught two touchdowns from the bench while Dalton Kincaid fumbled in the lineup, and that one swap turns a loss into a win. The call that did land, Josh Allen over Jared Goff, landed by 0.10, the same sliver that separated @TurkeyTime1 and @ActuallyLogan in different games and bought neither of them anything. Meanwhile @jmass ran the tidiest lineup in La Liga, and @kellengil won with the eighth-best score, a reminder that the schedule makes a fine assistant GM.

Up top, @alysson2114 rides Jahmyr Gibbs into first, and @alexeldeib stays perfect with Jaxon Smith-Njigba doing everything, passing included. That's three 3-0 teams and three 0-3 teams, with a nervous middle class in between. Next week @jmass takes a swing at @alexeldeib's unbeaten record, and @sedwards1495 meets @Wasabi209 with the projections calling it a coin flip. By Sunday night, La Liga finds out whether Harold Fannin was a gust or the forecast.

copy.news:
I found 7 confirmed on-field moments involving your league's players. One caveat first: my search tool hit its usage limit after the first query, so everything below comes from ESPN's Week 3 highlights and takeaways pages and NFL.com's highlight video listings. I couldn't confirm any memes, bloopers or sideline drama from established outlets, so none are included. Some of these may also have gone viral, but I couldn't check social media buzz.

- **Tyler Loop (👩‍🍳 Cook coop conk):** He kicked a 56-yard field goal with no time left to beat the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro. People are talking about it because it was a walk-off win on international soil and a comeback that pushed back on the "same old Ravens" reputation for blowing fourth-quarter leads. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50043408/week-3-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026

- **Lamar Jackson and CeeDee Lamb (both EaglesRx):** They were on opposite sides of that Rio game. Jackson threw 2 TDs in the comeback, and Lamb had 112 yards for Dallas in the loss. The same manager got points from both teams in the week's most dramatic finish. https://www.nfl.com/videos/channel/game-highlights-vc

- **Jaylen Warren (You'll Never CMC Me Again):** ESPN called it a "career outing" in Pittsburgh's win over the AFC North rival Bengals. It was a breakout game against a division rival. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50034932/best-plays-moments-touchdowns-more

- **Drake Maye (You'll Never CMC Me Again):** ESPN described "another turnover-filled afternoon," listing it among the early window's shocking performances. It's a talking point because it's becoming a pattern, not a one-off. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50043408/week-3-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026

- **Jahmyr Gibbs (Never Gonna Gibbs You Up):** He scored 3 touchdowns, one of the headline performances of Sunday's early games. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50043408/week-3-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026

- **Matthew Stafford (EaglesRx) and Davante Adams (sedwards1495):** Stafford threw for 403 yards and 2 TDs, and Adams had 137 receiving yards. They still lost to Denver in a game ABC7/ESPN called a "primetime classic." https://www.nfl.com/videos/channel/game-highlights-vc

- **Bo Nix and DEN D/ST (both Like a Good Nabers):** Nix threw 2 TDs as the Broncos rallied late to beat the Rams. Denver safety Talanoa Hufanga had a sack and 2 interceptions, returning one for a touchdown, which is a big day for that manager's defense. The flip side is a tough week for LAR D/ST (TurkeyTime1). https://www.nfl.com/videos/channel/game-highlights-vc

**Also worth knowing:** ESPN listed Sam Darnold (The (P)Rice is Right) among Sunday's big stat days. Seattle, the defending Super Bowl champs, still lost to the Commanders, who were led by backup QB Marcus Mariota. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50034932/best-plays-moments-touchdowns-more
